scenarios.name: parent_substitution_before_receiver_open
scenarios.attacker: medium-integrity same user renames the receiver parent
scenarios.preconditions: receiver directory configured, not yet opened
scenarios.action: replace the parent path, then start the receiver open
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED before TRANSFER_STARTED; no artifact accepted
scenarios.evidence: receiver log reason initial_path_substitution; substitute directory empty of wheels
scenarios.privileges: medium integrity of the interactive user

scenarios.name: parent_substitution_between_validation_and_open
scenarios.attacker: same user, timed after any stat and before CreateFileW
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED; lstat is not treated as success
scenarios.evidence: opened file id differs from the id captured at create, or open never proceeds

scenarios.name: parent_substitution_after_open
scenarios.attacker: same user renames after the handle exists
scenarios.action: rename the path and place a new directory there
scenarios.expected: later creates stay on the original handle; new directory receives nothing

scenarios.name: receiving_directory_substitution
scenarios.attacker: same user replaces the receiver directory object
scenarios.preconditions: directory created by the receiver SID
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED if the replacement succeeds; test fails the design if the user can replace it

scenarios.name: publication_directory_substitution
scenarios.attacker: same user replaces the publication directory
scenarios.expected: commit uses the bound handle only; swapped path gets no commit record
scenarios.evidence: commit file id matches the bound directory

scenarios.name: build_consumer_directory_substitution
scenarios.attacker: same user swaps a path the consumer was told to open
scenarios.preconditions: consumer is instructed to use a path
scenarios.expected: design forbids path consumption; a consumer that opens the path is FAILED_CLOSED and is not PUBLICATION_COMMITTED
scenarios.evidence: no path open in the consumer log

scenarios.name: junction_insertion
scenarios.attacker: same user creates a junction at the receiver path
scenarios.expected: reparse attribute fails closed
scenarios.evidence: reason symlink_or_reparse; junction target has no wheels

scenarios.name: directory_symlink_insertion
scenarios.attacker: same user creates a directory symlink
scenarios.action: create the symlink or record the creation error
scenarios.expected: if created, reparse attribute fails closed; if creation fails, the case is NOT_EXECUTED and is not a pass
scenarios.privileges: whatever symlink creation requires; do not change developer mode

scenarios.name: other_reparse_tags
scenarios.attacker: a reparse point that is not a junction or symlink
scenarios.preconditions: a tag can be created without host policy changes
scenarios.action: present that object as the directory
scenarios.expected: reparse attribute fails closed; tags that cannot be created stay NOT_EXECUTED
scenarios.evidence: attribute bit and tag if safely readable

scenarios.name: cross_volume
scenarios.attacker: child create lands on another volume
scenarios.preconditions: a second volume exists or the case is not executed
scenarios.expected: unexpected_volume fails closed; absence of a second volume is NOT_EXECUTED

scenarios.name: acl_mutation_by_current_user
scenarios.attacker: interactive user rewrites the receiver DACL
scenarios.preconditions: directory owned by the receiver SID
scenarios.action: attempt to grant the interactive user write
scenarios.expected: mutation fails for medium integrity; if it succeeds, the design is FAILED and implementation stops
scenarios.evidence: error from the ACL call, or a recorded success that blocks the design
scenarios.privileges: medium integrity first; elevation is a separate not-claimed case

scenarios.name: ownership_mutation
scenarios.attacker: interactive user takes ownership
scenarios.action: take ownership without elevation, then with a note if elevation would be required
scenarios.expected: medium-integrity attempt fails; elevated success is recorded as administrator-class and is not a claimed defense

scenarios.name: receiver_executable_replacement
scenarios.attacker: same user replaces the receiver binary
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED if the user can write that directory; the design is invalid unless the write fails
scenarios.evidence: binary hash unchanged or start refused

scenarios.name: receiver_configuration_replacement
scenarios.attacker: same user replaces the allowlist file
scenarios.action: point the allowlist at the attacker SID
scenarios.expected: write fails, or the receiver refuses a config not bound at start by the receiver SID

scenarios.name: receiver_impersonation
scenarios.attacker: same user offers a pipe server with the receiver's name
scenarios.expected: sender rejects a server SID that is not the receiver SID

scenarios.name: sender_impersonation
scenarios.attacker: a process with a different SID connects as the sender
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED sender_sid_mismatch; no file created
scenarios.evidence: log contains the rejected SID and no hash commit
scenarios.privileges: medium integrity of a non-allowlisted SID

scenarios.name: handle_substitution
scenarios.attacker: sender passes a directory handle
scenarios.action: offer DuplicateHandle of an attacker directory
scenarios.expected: receiver ignores the handle and does not write there
scenarios.evidence: no write on the attacker handle

scenarios.name: handle_reuse
scenarios.attacker: reuse a file handle after the transfer was failed
scenarios.preconditions: FAILED_CLOSED with a handle still open
scenarios.action: ask the receiver to publish that handle
scenarios.expected: state machine refuses; no commit

scenarios.name: use_after_close
scenarios.attacker: call write after directory close
scenarios.expected: handle_closed; no file

scenarios.name: interrupted_transfer
scenarios.attacker: sender drops the pipe mid-body
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED; unpublished partial

scenarios.name: partial_artifact
scenarios.attacker: declared size larger than bytes sent
scenarios.expected: size mismatch FAILED_CLOSED

scenarios.name: duplicate_artifact_name
scenarios.attacker: send the same basename twice
scenarios.expected: destination_exists; no overwrite

scenarios.name: case_insensitive_collision
scenarios.attacker: send Name.whl then name.whl
scenarios.expected: case_collision before create

scenarios.name: unicode_collision
scenarios.attacker: two NFC/NFD or confusable spellings
scenarios.action: send a non-NFC name or a second normalization
scenarios.expected: name rejected; no second file

scenarios.name: path_traversal
scenarios.attacker: name contains .. or a slash
scenarios.expected: path_traversal; no create

scenarios.name: alternate_data_stream
scenarios.attacker: name contains a colon
scenarios.expected: path_traversal; no ADS created
scenarios.evidence: reason and absence of a stream

scenarios.name: reserved_device_names
scenarios.attacker: NUL, CON, COM1, or a reserved stem
scenarios.expected: reserved_device_name
scenarios.evidence: no device file and no ordinary file with that name

scenarios.name: oversized_artifact
scenarios.attacker: body above the configured maximum
scenarios.preconditions: maximum set by the future approval
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED before the extra byte is stored
scenarios.evidence: stored length at or below the cap

scenarios.name: excessive_artifact_count
scenarios.attacker: count above the configured maximum
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED; extra file not created

scenarios.name: malformed_wheel
scenarios.attacker: bytes that are not a valid wheel ZIP
scenarios.preconditions: BYTES_VERIFIED would otherwise pass a hash of the bad bytes
scenarios.action: send them with a matching self-hash
scenarios.expected: wheel integrity fails; hash match is not enough

scenarios.name: malformed_METADATA
scenarios.attacker: wheel whose METADATA is broken
scenarios.expected: WHEEL_METADATA_VERIFIED not entered

scenarios.name: malformed_RECORD
scenarios.attacker: RECORD digest does not match a member
scenarios.expected: RECORD check fails closed

scenarios.name: missing_dependency_edge
scenarios.attacker: METADATA requires a package that was not received
scenarios.expected: assert_dependency_graph fails; no publication

scenarios.name: incorrect_marker_evaluation
scenarios.attacker: marker that does not match the target
scenarios.preconditions: marker parser returns unknown or false
scenarios.expected: unknown marker fails; false marker drops the edge only when the target profile is known
scenarios.evidence: marker result not treated as true

scenarios.name: unapproved_source
scenarios.attacker: claims an index that is not approved
scenarios.action: present pypi.org or any other host as approved
scenarios.expected: PROVENANCE_VERIFIED not entered

scenarios.name: unapproved_redirect
scenarios.attacker: provenance includes a redirect off the approved host
scenarios.preconditions: no live request in this test; the URL list is local
scenarios.expected: FAILED_CLOSED; no socket
scenarios.evidence: reason unapproved_redirect and zero network attempts

scenarios.name: synthetic_only_lock
scenarios.attacker: lock marked SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY
scenarios.expected: publication refused

scenarios.name: incompatible_wheel_tag
scenarios.attacker: wheel tag outside the known set
scenarios.preconditions: tag set is currently unknown, so every real tag fails
scenarios.action: send a wheel with a tag
scenarios.expected: TARGET_COMPATIBILITY_VERIFIED not entered

scenarios.name: post_verification_replacement
scenarios.attacker: replace file bytes after BYTES_VERIFIED and before commit
scenarios.action: attempt to change the file through another open
scenarios.expected: re-read hash mismatch or ACL denial; no commit

scenarios.name: post_publication_replacement
scenarios.attacker: change bytes after a commit record exists
scenarios.preconditions: a test-only commit in a disposable directory
scenarios.expected: consumer read refused when re-read hash or file id changes

scenarios.name: crash_during_publication
scenarios.attacker: process kill after partial commit write
scenarios.action: terminate before the commit record is complete
scenarios.expected: recovery finds no valid commit and does not publish
scenarios.privileges: test harness may terminate only the prototype process

scenarios.name: concurrent_receiver_sessions
scenarios.attacker: two transfers at once
scenarios.expected: second session FAILED_CLOSED; no interleaved names
scenarios.evidence: one session id in the commit

scenarios.name: unauthorized_consumer
scenarios.attacker: SID not on the allowlist reads the pipe
scenarios.expected: no bytes sent

scenarios.name: production_mount_exposure
scenarios.attacker: ask to publish into a production path
scenarios.expected: refused; production paths are not opened

scenarios.name: credential_exposure
scenarios.attacker: artifact or config named as a backup or .env file
scenarios.action: use the two backup filenames or a .env name
scenarios.expected: rejected by name; contents never read

scenarios.name: broker_network_access
scenarios.attacker: receiver or test tries to reach OANDA
scenarios.expected: not attempted; if a future harness uses a sink, the sink is not OANDA

scenarios.name: database_network_access
scenarios.attacker: receiver or test tries to reach production PostgreSQL
scenarios.expected: not attempted

scenarios.name: docker_socket_exposure
scenarios.attacker: receiver opens the Docker pipe
scenarios.preconditions: socket not in the receiver token's plan
scenarios.expected: not attempted; a test that the path is absent from the allowlist
scenarios.evidence: no docker command and no pipe open

scenarios.name: failure_to_close_handles
scenarios.attacker: exception path skips CloseHandle
scenarios.expected: failure path still closes; a leaked handle is a test failure

scenarios.name: recovery_after_interrupted_operation
scenarios.attacker: restart the receiver after FAILED_CLOSED
scenarios.preconditions: partial files left in the receiver directory
scenarios.action: start again and ask to publish the leftovers
scenarios.expected: leftovers are not a commit; a new transfer is required; historical files outside the prototype are not deleted
